fusions.name: Rim Bash
fusions.desc: Slams the edge of a guard forward for 12 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipped Stone
fusions.desc: Skims a rim-edge disc that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Raised Decoy
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 5% while it stands.

fusions.name: Glancing Blows
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
